    <desc id="structure-paper-desc">葉片局部立體橫切示意。柵狀葉肉細胞緊密排列；海綿葉肉細胞之間形成氣室，朝向氣室的細胞表面覆有水膜。上、下表皮細胞及保衞細胞均畫有液泡，兩個保衞細胞之間保留沒有橫線的氣孔開口。維管束中木質部在上、韌皮部在下；莖和葉的木質導管均為粉紅色。藍色箭嘴表示水份運輸及滲透，橙色虛線箭嘴表示水汽移動與擴散。橙色數字對應經氣孔進行的蒸騰兩步，藍色數字對應蒸騰拉力的形成三步。</desc>

questions.heading: 1. 光強度與水跡上移速度有甚麼關係？
questions.sentence: 當光強度增加時，紅色水跡的平均上移速度通常會 __________。

questions.heading: 2. 葉片有甚麼作用？
questions.sentence: 在相同的 20 cm 光照距離下，帶葉的裝置B的水跡平均上移速度比不帶葉的裝置D __________。

questions.heading: 2. 葉片有甚麼作用？
questions.sentence: 這個比較支持葉片 __________ 的推論。

options.text: 與水分向上運輸沒有關係

questions.heading: 3. 本實驗能告訴我們甚麼？
questions.sentence: 我們只量度了紅色水跡的高度，沒有量度葉片散失的水汽。以下哪個說法最恰當？__________

options.text: 紅色水跡可作為植物吸水及水分向上運輸的線索，但無法代表葉片的蒸騰速率（即水分由氣孔散失的速度）。
水跡上移速度就是葉片散失水汽的速率，可直接當作蒸騰速率。
只要帶葉組比不帶葉組快，就已完全證明水汽只經氣孔散失。

reflection.question: 綜合實驗結果與學習重點，解釋光強度及葉片如何影響水分運輸，並說明蒸騰與蒸騰拉力的形成。

texts.observation: 過了一段時間後，紅色水跡沿西芹長柄內的部分區域向上延伸。
texts.hypothesis: 此題沒有固定答案；假說應能透過改變光強度和量度水跡上移速度來測試。
texts.reason: 說明你預期光照與水分運輸有何關係；預測毋須猜中結果。
texts.control: 裝置D 不帶葉，與帶葉的裝置B 比較；兩者皆為 20 cm 光照距離，其餘條件相同，主要差別是葉片有無。
texts.design: 材料：西芹 ×4、檯燈 ×4、紅色水杯 ×4、30 cm 尺子 ×4、剪刀 ×1、計時器 ×1。三株帶葉西芹的燈距為 10、20、30 cm；不帶葉組與其中一個帶葉組保持相同燈距。各浸入紅色水 2 cm。

dv: 紅色水跡上升高度／平均上移速度
cv: 紅色水濃度及浸入深度
西芹長柄的長度及粗幼

assumptions.text: 改變燈距不會造成各裝置溫度不同。
assumptions.reference: 溫度亦可能影響蒸騰。此模擬維持各裝置 25°C，避免光照與溫度同時改變。

assumptions.text: 裝置A、裝置B、裝置C 的總葉面積相同。
assumptions.reference: 葉面積可能影響水分散失，因此帶葉組裝置A、裝置B、裝置C 應保持相同總葉面積；不帶葉的裝置D 是另一項比較。

assumptions.text: 葉面積不會影響結果，因此毋須控制。
assumptions.reference: 不能把葉面積視為沒有影響；它可能影響水分散失，光照比較中需要控制。

assumptions.text: 各裝置的濕度及氣流相同。
assumptions.reference: 濕度及氣流亦可能影響蒸騰，因此比較光照時應保持相同。

labels.葉的內部構造與蒸騰: Internal leaf structure and transpiration (蒸騰)
labels.橙色數字：經氣孔進行的蒸騰 ｜ 藍色數字：蒸騰拉力的形成: Orange numbers: transpiration (蒸騰) through stomata (氣孔) | Blue numbers: how transpiration pull (蒸騰拉力) forms
labels.莖內的木質導管: Xylem vessels (木質導管) in the stem
labels.減少水份散失、保護葉片: Reduces water loss; protects the leaf
labels.柵狀葉肉細胞: Palisade mesophyll cells (柵狀葉肉細胞)
labels.海綿葉肉細胞: Spongy mesophyll cells (海綿葉肉細胞)
labels.細胞排列疏鬆，其間形成氣室: Loosely packed cells with air spaces (氣室)
labels.控制氣孔開合；含葉綠體: Control stomatal opening (氣孔張開); contain chloroplasts (葉綠體)
labels.蒸騰拉力的形成: How transpiration pull (蒸騰拉力) forms
labels.水份從葉肉細胞表面蒸發，並進入氣室中。: Water evaporates (蒸發) from the surfaces of mesophyll cells (葉肉細胞) into the air spaces (氣室).
labels.氣室內的水汽經氣孔擴散到大氣中。: Water vapour (水汽) in the air spaces (氣室) diffuses through stomata (氣孔) into the air.
labels.水份從葉肉細胞散失，細胞的水勢因而下降。: Mesophyll cells (葉肉細胞) lose water, so their water potential falls.
labels.葉肉細胞藉滲透從鄰近細胞吸收水份。: Mesophyll cells (葉肉細胞) take in water from nearby cells by osmosis.
labels.木質導管內的水被抽出，形成蒸騰拉力。: Water is drawn out of the xylem vessels (木質導管), creating transpiration pull (蒸騰拉力).
labels.局部放大示意，並非按比例。實驗中的西芹長柄實際是葉柄；本圖的莖部用作說明木質導管: Enlarged view, not to scale. The celery stalk in this experiment is a petiole (葉柄). The stem shown here explains transport through xylem vessels (木質導管).

questions.heading: 1. How is light intensity (光強度) related to the upward speed of the water trace?
questions.sentence: As light intensity (光強度) increases, the average upward speed of the red water trace usually will __________.

questions.heading: 2. What is the role of leaves?
questions.sentence: At the same 20 cm lamp distance, the red-trace speed in leafy setup B, compared with leafless setup D, is __________.

questions.heading: 2. What is the role of leaves?
questions.sentence: This comparison supports the idea that leaves __________.

options.text: have no effect on water moving upwards

questions.heading: 3. What can this experiment tell us?
questions.sentence: We measured only the height of the red water trace. We did not measure water vapour (水汽) lost from the leaves. Which statement is most suitable?__________

options.text: The red water trace indicates water uptake and upward water transport, but does not represent leaf transpiration rate (蒸騰速率) (the rate of water loss through stomata (氣孔)).
The upward speed of the water trace is the rate of water vapour (水汽) loss from leaves and can be used directly as the transpiration rate (蒸騰速率).
If the setups with leaves are faster than the setup without leaves, this fully proves that water vapour (水汽) is lost only through stomata (氣孔).

reflection.question: Using the experimental results and learning points, explain how light intensity (光強度) and leaves affect water transport, and explain how transpiration (蒸騰) and transpiration pull (蒸騰拉力) arise.

texts.observation: After some time, the red water trace extends upwards in some parts inside the celery stalk.
texts.hypothesis: There is no single answer. Your hypothesis should be testable (可測試的) by changing light intensity (光強度) and measuring the upward speed of the water trace.
texts.reason: Explain the link you expect between light and water transport. Your prediction does not have to match the final result.
texts.control: Compare setup D without leaves with setup B with leaves. Both have a lamp distance of 20 cm and the same other conditions. The main difference is whether leaves are present.
texts.design: Materials: 4 celery stalks, 4 desk lamps, 4 cups of red water, 4 rulers of 30 cm, 1 pair of scissors and 1 timer. Set the lamp distances for the three celery stalks with leaves to 10, 20 and 30 cm. Use the same lamp distance for the setup without leaves and one setup with leaves. Immerse each stalk 2 cm into the red water.

dv: 紅色水跡上升高度／平均上移速度
cv: 紅色水濃度及浸入深度
西芹長柄的長度及粗幼

assumptions.text: Changing the lamp distance does not make the setups have different temperatures.
assumptions.reference: 溫度亦可能影響蒸騰。此模擬維持各裝置 25°C，避免光照與溫度同時改變。

assumptions.text: Setups A, B and C have the same total leaf area.
assumptions.reference: 葉面積可能影響水分散失，因此帶葉組裝置A、裝置B、裝置C 應保持相同總葉面積；不帶葉的裝置D 是另一項比較。

assumptions.text: Leaf area does not affect the results, so it does not need to be kept the same.
assumptions.reference: 不能把葉面積視為沒有影響；它可能影響水分散失，光照比較中需要控制。

assumptions.text: Humidity (濕度) and air movement are the same for all setups.
assumptions.reference: 濕度及氣流亦可能影響蒸騰，因此比較光照時應保持相同。

配分與完成條件
公式彙總
六項 SPS 各 4 分，共 24；新知識四項各 2，共 8；整體 32。教師填完該列所有適用評分格及學生完成反思，整體分數才顯示。
人工評分格空白＝待評，與填 0 分不同。公式由 Excel 開啟時重算；教師在此檔填分後請保存。
新下載 Excel 不會讀取之前檔案內的人工分數；分數只存於教師保存的 Excel。
色彩與研究使用
說明
底色區分 SPS 類別及新知識；綠字正確／滿分，紅字錯誤／零分，橙字部分得分，未評中性色。
人工答案在填分後依公式變色。PDF 不顯示任何分數；活動紀錄不是 SPS 分數。
本 rubric 為 VL2 初稿；正式縱向比較前需對四個模組統一準則、配分及評分者校準。
